description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, staff or moderator only): read the abuse queue and decide one report (GET /api/v1/admin/abuse, POST /api/v1/admin/abuse/:id/:action) — hold, activate, pause or takedown a share. A staff decision is audited with the moderator's subject and the evidence, not the request body; a takedown is also announced to Domains for a custom hostname. This is an internal moderation capability, never delegated to user or app tokens.
